#!/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

# Compile and run the program
cc -Wall -Wextra -pedantic fizzbuzz.c -otest_fizzbuzz 2>&1
./test_fizzbuzz > actual_output.txt

# Show the lines around line 13 to verify "2" appears on its own
echo "--- Lines 12-14 of output ---"
sed -n '12,14p' actual_output.txt

# Verify that specific test lines are present
echo "--- Checking requirements ---"
[[ "$(sed -n '13p' actual_output.txt)" == "2" ]] && echo "Line 13 is '2': PASS" || echo "Line 13 is NOT '2': FAIL ($(sed -n '13p' actual_output.txt))"
assert_line() {
    local line_num="$1" expected_text="$2"
    if [[ "$(sed -n "${line_num}p" actual_output.txt)" == "$expected_text" ]]; then
        echo "Line $line_num: '$expected_text': PASS"
    else
        echo "Line $line_num: FAILED (got '$(sed -n "${line_num}p" actual_output.txt)', expected '$expected_text'): FAIL"
    fi
}
assert_line 14 "3 fizz"
assert_line 16 "5 buzz"
assert_line 27 "15 fizz buzz"

# Check total line count (should be exactly 100)
line_count=$(wc -l < actual_output.txt)
echo "Total lines: $line_count (expected 100): $( [ "$line_count" -eq 100 ] && echo 'PASS' || echo 'FAIL')"

# Diff against expected output generated on the fly
gen_expected() {
    for i in $(seq 1 100); do
        printf "%d" "$i"
        if [ $((i % 3)) -eq 0 ]; then printf " fizz"; fi
        if [ $((i % 5)) -eq 0 ]; then printf " buzz"; fi
        printf "\n"
    done
}

diff <(gen_expected) actual_output.txt && echo "--- Full diff: no differences (PASS) ---" || echo "--- Full diff: FAIL ---"

# Cleanup temp files
rm -f test_fizzbuzz actual_output.txt test_fizzbuzz.c
